Initial GCC native run missing prefix oracle: incomplete
Initial zero code guard reference: replaced by nonzero guard before final timings
V8 inspection timings: debugger/JIT dumping and overlapping correctness work

limitations: Two captured kernels, one game; not a universal WASM overhead estimate

Whole-game trials retain shared-host outliers; no separate variance investigation
Static code sizes and stack operands do not measure executed cost
